verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud is a managed data service with AI features such as AI Functions and AI notebooks, so a training-data opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no AI-training policy, opt-out control or data-usage commitment. Self-hosting and local-run options are documented, but nothing ties them to preventing data from being used for model training, so they cannot be credited here.
